name: Connor M. McCann
title: Assistant Professor
department: Robotics Engineering; affiliated Mechanical & Materials and Biomedical Engineering
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with a specifically external-master visiting-internship inquiry option and substantive prior learned assistive-robot execution. Current group spans mechanics and prototyping, so a software/ML project needs individual alignment.

physicalEvidence.summary: The August 2025 Nature Communications paper runs a personalized two-layer neural classifier on IMU/compression data at 100Hz onboard a portable shoulder-assist robot. Its UP/HOLD/DOWN output modifies assistance through a physics-based hysteresis model. Nine participants were evaluated, with two later home demonstrations; simulated functional tasks means real physical tasks approximating daily activities. McCann is credited for methodology and software, but Harvard led this prior work. WPI hardware transfer and current access are unverified. Results do not establish unrestricted clinical efficacy.
